parent.body:
As a restaurant owner, I want to create menu items and define their recipes with ingredients and quantities, so that the system can automatically calculate the cost per dish.                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
    ### Acceptance Criteria                                                                                                                                                                                      
    - [ ] User can create, edit, and delete menu items with their selling prices.                                                                                                                                
    - [ ] User can attach multiple ingredients with specified quantities to a menu item (Recipe/BOM).                                                                                                            
    - [ ] The system dynamically calculates and displays the cost per dish based on recipe ingredients.                                                                                                          
    - [ ] Cross-tenant check prevents adding ingredients from other restaurants into recipes.
